description: One CLI for all your robots. Connect them, command them, and let them work together, each with an LLM for a brain. Microduck, Open Duck Mini, LeRobot arms, XLeRobot carts, AlohaMini, ToddlerBot or any ROS base. Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, or local via Ollama or vLLM. Simulator, .duck safety contracts, MCP, memory between runs, flocks.
summary: 🦆🧠 Give your small robot a brain. Tell a Microduck, an Open Duck Mini you built yourself, a Reachy Mini, a LeRobot arm or any ROS base what you want in human language. An LLM (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, or a local model via Ollama, vLLM or llama.cpp) uses the skills it already has. Simulator, .du
